picks.editorial_note: A $100M NSF program to build regional AI compute hubs is one of the largest coordinated investments this week in democratizing AI infrastructure access for scientific research and workforce development nationwide.
picks.title: New NSF State and Regional AI Infrastructure Hubs will power AI-enabled scientific research across the country

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's deployment of the first AI-driven telescope marks a genuine technical first for autonomous scientific instrumentation, part of the DOE's broader push to embed AI directly into discovery pipelines.
picks.title: First AI-driven telescope goes stargazing

picks.editorial_note: NIST's formal MOU with the DOE under the White House-led Genesis Mission signals a national policy commitment to accelerating AI-driven science, aligning standards-setting with federal research priorities.
picks.title: NIST Joins National Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI Innovation

picks.editorial_note: RPI leading and contributing to two DOE Genesis Mission projects underscores universities' growing role as core partners in the federal government's flagship AI-for-science initiative.
picks.title: RPI Selected for Two U.S. Department of Energy Genesis Mission Projects

picks.editorial_note: A $24.9M NSF grant to build a nationally accessible self-driving laboratory for metals could dramatically accelerate materials discovery for researchers across the country, not just at Texas A&M.
picks.title: Texas A&M to build self-driving laboratory for metals, open to researchers nationwide – Texas A&M Stories

picks.editorial_note: NSF's $50M investment in two Materials Innovation Platforms expands the national infrastructure for autonomous, AI-driven materials research at scale.
picks.title: NSF stands up 2 Materials Innovation Platforms with $50M investment

picks.editorial_note: Virginia Tech's $20M award to build a cloud-based, AI-enabled semiconductor lab adds a key node to the federal Genesis Mission's network of automated national research facilities.
picks.title: University receives $20 million grant for cloud-based semiconductor lab
picks.university: Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech's leadership of a new national Programmable Cloud Laboratory positions the university at the center of a multi-institution push to automate materials and manufacturing research with AI.
picks.title: Georgia Tech to Lead National Cloud Laboratory for Advanced Manufacturing and Materials

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's new AI modeling framework, which combines thermodynamics with machine learning to predict solid-state reaction pathways, is a substantive methodological advance for materials synthesis prediction.
picks.title: New AI Modeling Approach Accelerates the Development of Advanced Materials

picks.editorial_note: MIT Lincoln Lab and Mass General's AI-GUIDE ultrasound device, honored with a national tech-transfer award, shows AI already saving lives in real-world pre-hospital trauma care.
picks.title: Life-saving Lincoln Laboratory technology wins 2026 excellence in technology transfer award
